entries.title: Report cards: ⋮ menu, new PDF, email to family
entries.body: Every report card list now has a ⋮ menu: view, edit, download, print, email to the family, approve, send back and delete draft. Editing a sent card makes a new version that is approved again. The PDF now shows your agency details, the educator, both signatures and the approval date. Writing a new card has its own tab: ✨ Generate with AI.

entries.title: Notes: tidy list, roomier box, pictures
entries.body: Your notes list now shows just each note's title on one line. Tap it to read the whole note. Writing a note has its own optional Title line and a bigger box that grows as you type. You can also add up to 5 pictures to a note: paste a screenshot, drop a picture on it, or press 🖼 Add picture (camera or photos on a phone). Pictures are seen only by the people who can see the note.

entries.title: Archived report cards
entries.body: Agency admins can now tap Archived on the All report cards list to see the report cards of children who have left and centres that have closed. They open read-only, with the PDF.

entries.title: Tours for your centre
entries.body: Centre directors now see and manage the tour bookings for their own centre under Tours: confirm, mark completed or no-show, or cancel. Tours at other centres stay with them and your agency admins.

entries.title: All report cards in one list
entries.body: The Report cards screen now lists every report card you can see, with who made it and whether it is a draft, awaiting approval or sent. Filter by status, term, who made it or centre, search for a child, and tap a card to open it.

entries.title: AI usage: see who uses AI, with true costs
entries.body: Platform > AI usage > Breakdown now has its own date range, four summary tiles and one table at a time: By feature, By agency, By model and the new By user (name, role, agency, centre, calls, tokens, cost, last used and top features). Click a person to see their recent AI calls. Costs now use each model's own price (Haiku, Sonnet for pictures, Opus), so they are much closer to the real bill.

entries.title: Play Spark with AI off
entries.body: If AI is switched off for your agency, Play Spark stays open: saved ideas and their pictures, We did it, the library, Team ideas, the monthly report and Play at home all keep working. Only new ideas and material scans wait until AI is back on.

entries.title: Team ideas in Play Spark
entries.body: Directors and admins can now see every Play Spark idea their educators made, not just shared ones. Open Play Spark > Library > 👥 Team ideas: admins see the whole agency, directors the centres they run. Each idea shows who made it, the room and the date. It is read only: Print it, or Save a copy to my ideas to use it as your own. Needs the AI Bundle.

entries.title: Referral credits for KiddieTrac customers
entries.body: Thank a customer with a one-time credit off their invoice. Pick the customer, who they referred (any Sales lead or customer, or "No specific referral" with a reason that shows on the invoice), a $ amount or a % and the invoice month. It comes off before tax when that month is raised (or straight away on a draft), never takes the invoice below $0, and any unused $ carries to the next invoice. One credit per referral. Find it in Accounting AR/AP > Referral credits and on the customer record in Sales > Customers.

entries.title: Reminders before meetings and follow-ups
entries.body: Like Outlook, a reminder now pops up 15 minutes before your meetings, demos, bookings, follow-ups and tasks while KiddieTrac is open, with Join, Open, Snooze and Dismiss. Change the time, or turn it off, in My settings under Reminders.

entries.title: Reminders before meetings and tasks
entries.body: Like Outlook, a reminder now pops up 15 minutes before your meetings, calendar events and tasks while KiddieTrac is open, with Join, Open, Snooze and Dismiss. Change the time, or turn it off, in My settings under Reminders.

entries.title: Quick notes
entries.body: Jot a note in seconds from the 📓 button or Notes in your menu. Keep it just for you, or share it with your staff, and pin it, colour it, link it to a child, family or staff member, or set a reminder that shows in your calendar.

entries.title: Switches only for your role
entries.body: Notify me about now lists only what your role receives in the agency you are working in - admins no longer see parent switches, and directors can now reach theirs. If you are staff and a parent there, each switch says which.

entries.title: Choose which notices reach you
entries.body: Admins and directors can now switch each kind of notice on or off for themselves in Settings → Notifications → Notify me about: team clock-ins, absences, forms to countersign, staff certificates, payments, copies of parent billing reminders, pick-up list changes, closures, schedule changes and tips. Safety alerts always reach you. Your own Safe Arrival and other safety alerts now also show by name at the top of the 🔔 bell.

entries.title: Centres included in the Reseller bundle, and bigger SMS blocks
entries.body: The Reseller bundle includes 5 centres, and each Reseller extra centre adds one more. Your open centres always stay open and closed centres don't count. When you reach the limit, opening another centre shows an Upgrade popup. Each SMS Incremental block now raises both your monthly text and call allowance.

entries.title: Locked features show as Upgrade, and plan changes are clearer
entries.body: Agency admins now see features that are not in your plan greyed out with an Upgrade badge. Tap one to see what it does and which plan or add-on includes it, and ask us to add it. Staff and families still only see what your plan includes. Safe Arrival and the parent phone line are part of the SMS & voice add-on. If your plan gets smaller, invoicing and autopay keep running until the end of the period already paid.

entries.title: Staff copies of billing reminders: one on/off switch
entries.body: Settings → Billing → Reminders → Who gets a copy now has one switch, Send staff a copy of each reminder. Turn it on and choose agency admins, the invoice centre’s directors, your billing contact address and any staff you pick. Copies are hidden (BCC) from families. You can also copy each new invoice emailed on its own date. Off by default for new agencies.

entries.title: Add-ons take effect straight away
entries.body: When your plan or an add-on changes, the menu and tiles follow it the next time the app opens - no need to sign out and back in. Screens that are not part of your plan (for example Trends on plans below Agency) are no longer shown only to say they are unavailable.

entries.title: One scrollbar on Late pickups
entries.body: Late pickups (and a few other cards with wide tables) showed a second, empty scrollbar under the table. Now there is just the table's own. The Notifications list also scrolls with the page instead of in a box of its own.

entries.title: Every banner has its moving picture
entries.body: Families, Children, Users, Centres and the agency overview now show the same floating, gently moving icon on their banner as every other screen. Privacy requests (📥) and Customers (🥇) also got their own icons, so no two screens in the menu share one.

entries.title: No more "Saved" when you close a chat
entries.body: Taking a conversation off your chat list, restoring it, website-chat actions and marking an announcement read no longer flash "Saving… Saved". The Saved message now only appears when you actually change a setting or save something.

entries.title: Your calendar: directors and sales
entries.body: Centre directors can now add their own mailbox in Email, and connect its calendar in My settings, Calendar. The sales team connects an Outlook or Google calendar directly - calendar only, never email.

entries.title: Connect Outlook or Google calendar
entries.body: Optional: in My settings, Calendar, connect the calendar of a Microsoft 365 or Gmail mailbox you use in Email. Its events show in your My day panel, and meetings you organise go on it with a Teams or Meet link, invitations sent from your own mailbox.

entries.title: My day: a right panel like Outlook
entries.body: On a computer there is now a thin bar on the right of every screen with Calendar, Meetings, Tasks and Today at the centre, like Outlook. The calendar lists what is coming up the way Outlook does: Today and Tomorrow headings, start times with how long each lasts, the next event tinted with Up next, and finished ones dropping off. Choose how far ahead it looks (today, 3 days, 1 week, 2 weeks or 1 month) with the gear or in My settings. Add private to-dos for yourself: Me is picked first in Add a task, and only you can ever see them. Ratio alerts check every room in every centre you look after, grouped by centre. Super admins and the sales team also see sales bookings and follow-ups in pink. Click the arrow to fold it away; it remembers your choice.

entries.title: Parents can answer arrival texts with 1 or 2
entries.body: Safe Arrival and morning check-in reminder texts now end with "Reply 1 if running late, 2 if absent today." A reply is recorded exactly like the parent doing it in the app (running late with a time they send back, or absent), the room and directors are told, and the parent gets a confirmation. Anything else they text still reaches you in chat as before.

entries.title: Reply 1 or 2 to the arrival text
entries.body: The text asking whether your child has arrived now ends with "Reply 1 if running late, 2 if absent today." Reply 1 and the centre knows your child is on the way (we then ask what time), or 2 and your child is marked absent. You get a text back confirming it.

entries.title: Parents can answer missed-child emails in one tap
entries.body: Families can now mark a child absent (with a reason and note) or running late (with a time) straight from the Safe Arrival and check-in reminder emails. It is recorded exactly as if they did it in the app: the room and directors are told, Safe Arrival stops chasing, and a running-late answer after a Safe Arrival no-show reopens the check so the child is still looked for. Every answer is in the audit log.

entries.title: Mark absent or running late from the email
entries.body: The "Has your child arrived?" and "We missed your child today" emails now have two buttons: Mark absent and Running late. Pick a reason or the time you will arrive, add a note if you like, and the centre is told straight away, just like in the app. The buttons work that day only.

entries.title: iLearn invoices now count as billed
entries.body: The admin digest now counts invoices raised in iLearn as well as KiddieTrac, so it no longer says families have no invoice when iLearn has billed them. It names the families with nothing billed for the month in either system. The bulk invoice run also skips families already invoiced for that month, including in iLearn, so nobody is billed twice.

entries.title: Find Play Spark ideas in search
entries.body: Type part of an idea's name in the top search box to find it: your own Play Spark ideas and the ones shared to your agency library, for the centres you look after. Tap one to open it in Play Spark.

entries.title: See the play, step by step
entries.body: Play Spark activities in your end-of-day email and in Play at home now show a picture of the finished activity and its steps, so you can set up your own at home. It is a drawing, never a photo of your child.

entries.title: Play Spark draws the end result
entries.body: Every Play Spark idea now comes with a picture: the finished set-up on top and numbered steps underneath, so you can see what it looks like before you start. Tap it to make it bigger. It is saved with the idea, prints with it, and activities on your weekly plan get one too once the plan is saved (tap 🎨 End result). AI Bundle.

entries.title: Tidier screens on your phone
entries.body: Lists that were cut off on a phone now show in full: Documents in My settings, Inspection forms and other record lists fit the screen as cards. Sub-tabs in Sales Bookings and Play Spark scroll in one row like everywhere else.

entries.title: The bottom bar shows what is open
entries.body: Tapping Phone, Add or One-Tap on the phone bar now lights that button while its panel is open, the same as every other tab, and the light moves back when you close it.

entries.title: Lesson plans are now part of Play Spark
entries.body: Play Spark is now the one place for play: This week (the weekly lesson plan families see), plus the Library of activity ideas. With the AI Bundle you also get Right now (a fresh idea for the room), Plan the week (AI-drafted weeks) and the monthly play report. Add a spark to the week with one tap, or tap one of today's planned activities to spark it.

entries.title: Quick menus all look the same
entries.body: Every short menu of choices (the phone bar Add and One-Tap buttons, Quick add, the chat + button, your name menu and the calendar Add button) now opens the same light see-through menu right by the button you tapped. Tap outside or press Esc to close it.

entries.title: Play Spark in the end-of-day emails
entries.body: Families see the Play Spark activity their child did, what it helps them learn, and an idea to try at home. Educators see the activities they ran and how many draft observations are waiting for review. The day view now names each Play Spark activity.

entries.title: Crisper icons on the phone bar
entries.body: The buttons on the bottom bar of the phone now have crisp new icons, with the screen you are on highlighted.

entries.title: Admin controls tidy themselves away
entries.body: Opened admin controls (View as and the agency switcher) fold away again after 15 seconds untouched. They stay open while you are using them or the person picker is open.

entries.title: One-Tap: show the centre code or scan a pickup pass
entries.body: The 📷 One-Tap button now gives two choices: show the centre’s code for parents (as before), or scan a temporary pickup person’s pass with the camera. A valid pass shows their photo and each child they can take, with a Check out button. A cancelled, used or expired pass alerts everyone. No camera? Type the 6-digit code instead.

entries.title: Scan a pickup pass, and see temporary pickups on the child
entries.body: At sign-out, tap 📷 Scan pass to read the QR on a temporary pickup person’s pass (typing the code still works). The child’s record now lists their temporary pickup people with photo, dates and status, and directors and admins can cancel one there. Today’s active ones print on the emergency card.

entries.title: Temporary pickup passes at sign-out
entries.body: When a parent adds a temporary pickup person, the room and director are told. At sign-out you see their photo: type the 6-digit code from their pass and tap Check code, then Check out. A wrong, old or cancelled code, or Not the right person, sends a high alert to the family, room, director and admins. Safe Arrival lists them, with Cancel.

entries.title: Temporary pickup people
entries.body: Someone else collecting your child once, or for up to 30 days? Add them in Family & pick-ups with their photo and mobile number. They get a text with a pickup code, staff check the code and their photo at sign-out, and you get a message the moment they pick up. A wrong or cancelled code alerts everyone straight away.

entries.title: Parents can report absences and late arrivals by phone
entries.body: Parents can now call the KiddieTrac line to report an absence or a late drop-off or pickup. It’s recorded just as if they’d used the app, after they prove who they are with a texted code or their phone PIN. If they can’t, they leave a message, and directors and admins approve or decline it under Safe Arrival → Phone messages from parents.

entries.title: Call in to report an absence or running late
entries.body: Call 1-855-400-9996 from your phone to report your child absent (today or tomorrow) or a late drop-off or pickup. To keep your child safe, we text a code to your phone during the call. Calling from a landline? Set a phone PIN in Running late → Call in instead.

entries.title: Safe Arrival tells the family when a child is marked absent
entries.body: If a child still isn’t signed in after every Safe Arrival check, the child is marked absent and the family gets a kind email (“We missed Ava today”) with what was tried and how to reach you. The educators and the people alerted get a copy. If the child is signed in later, the absence is removed. Change when this happens (after the last alert, at closing time, or never) in Safe Arrival settings.

entries.title: View the full email from a lead’s history
entries.body: Email entries on a lead show a short preview. Click 📧 View full email to read the whole message, with its formatting, and download its attachments, without leaving the lead. Opening it never marks the email read in the mailbox.

entries.title: Lead history now shows the emails you send
entries.body: Emails sent to a lead from the Sales mailboxes (sales@ and info@) now appear on the lead’s activity as 📤 Email to …, next to the ✉️ emails they send you. A lead created after you’ve already been emailing them picks up the last 90 days of that conversation within a few minutes.

entries.title: Emergency cards show the agency and educators
entries.body: Every emergency card now carries your agency’s name, logo, phone, email and address, and each educator’s phone and email. A part-time child on a day off still shows their regular provider. A child waitlisted after their provider closed no longer shows the old home; the card points to the guardians and the agency instead, and they now appear in the Children list.

entries.title: Careers: book interviews, keep on file, or decline kindly
entries.body: Each job application now has three actions: 📅 Book a meeting (you pick the time; they get a warm invitation with a Teams link and Accept / Maybe / Decline), 🗂️ Keep on file (kept 24 months, then removed automatically), and 💌 Decline politely. Add a personal note and see the exact email before it is sent.

entries.title: Search finds waitlisted families
entries.body: Global search now finds families, children and parents waiting for a new provider after theirs closed, tagged ⏳ Waitlisted. Their provider shows as "Waitlisted · unassigned" instead of the closed one, and you can edit their details and emergency contacts as usual.

entries.title: Waitlisted families are easy to find
entries.body: Families waiting for a new provider after theirs closed now show in the main Families list with a ⏳ Waitlisted tag. On the Children screen, the Waitlist filter and the search box find their children too.

entries.title: Play at home
entries.body: See the Play Spark activities your child did at the centre this month, with an easy way to try each one at home.

entries.title: Play Spark: a play idea, right now
entries.body: Tap Play Spark for an activity made for the children in your room right now, with a level for every age, the materials you have and a safety check. Tap We did it to log it to the daily record and draft observations. Part of the AI Bundle.

entries.title: Choose your Safe Arrival alerts
entries.body: Directors and admins can now choose how Safe Arrival reaches them: app, email, texts or calls. Go to Settings, then Notifications. Calls start off. Room educators are always told.

entries.title: Waitlisted families stay listed
entries.body: A family moved to the agency waitlist when their provider closes keeps its access and stays in Families and Users with a Waitlisted status until you place them. Filter Families by Waitlisted to find them.

entries.title: Support tickets go to KiddieTrac
entries.body: Every support request you raise now goes straight to the KiddieTrac team, who answer it. Your agency admins and directors are no longer alerted about each ticket.

entries.title: Smoother home screen
entries.body: Fixed a background loop on the home screen that could make KiddieTrac stop responding for several seconds, especially after the page had been open for a few hours or on a slower computer.

entries.title: Waitlist for families from a closed provider
entries.body: When a provider closes, you can now send each family to the Waitlist instead of only transferring or withdrawing them. They show as Previously at that provider, and admins and directors get an email. Press 🏠 Assign to place them with a new educator or centre; the child then joins that centre's waitlist, ready to Enrol.

entries.title: Reminders only for your forms
entries.body: Counter-signature reminders no longer list a form that belongs to another centre, even when the parent who signed it also has a child at yours.

entries.title: Payroll tiles for your centres
entries.body: Your dashboard's Payroll paid out and Next payroll tiles now show your centres' payroll, the same money your Payroll screen shows, instead of zero.

entries.title: Forms Manager for directors
entries.body: Centre directors now have Forms Manager. You see your centres' forms, sign-offs, packages and file requests, forms you upload belong to your centre, and agency-wide forms from your admin stay visible to you.

entries.title: Sub-tabs look the same everywhere
entries.body: Sub-tab rows such as Help's Guides and Training, and Users' Active and Invited, now use the same highlighted tab band as the rest of the portal, so you can always see which tab you are on.

entries.title: Missing menu screens fixed
entries.body: Privacy breaches now opens for centre directors, Notifications for auditors and Help for resellers - each used to show the dashboard instead. Directors no longer see an Archived switch on Children and Families, which only agency admins can open.

entries.title: Test tabs keep you signed in
entries.body: When a support or test sign-in kept in one browser tab ends, your own sign-in in your other tabs now stays put instead of being signed out with it.

entries.title: Directors get the same Dashboard, Children and Families screens
entries.body: Centre directors now see the same Dashboard as agency admins, limited to their own centres: every room, who is clocked in, the children at the centre, stat cards and business insights. Children and Families are the same screens too, with the same stat cards and menus. Directors see only the actions they are allowed to use: view a family and invite a parent, add a family, and edit children and enrolments. Staff now live in User management.

entries.title: A shorter Administration menu
entries.body: Locked sign-ins and Photo AI tagging are no longer in the sidebar. You can still pause or restore a sign-in from the person's, centre's or provider's own page.

entries.title: Ontario CWELCC base fees
entries.body: For Ontario centres, the CWELCC monthly report now follows the base fee model in place since 2025: base fee revenue, fee subsidy paid and parents paid, with no percentage. On the OCCMS screen, enter each age group's December 31, 2024 daily fee to see the base fee (the lower of $22 or that fee, never under $12). It flags any child whose fee works out above it, other charges to CWELCC families that must be optional, and closure days past 10 in a row or 20 a year.

entries.title: Meeting reminders for everyone invited
entries.body: Meetings booked on the Meetings screen now send each invited person a reminder about 30 minutes before the start, with the join button. KiddieTrac meetings also send a text when we have a number. Anyone who declined is left out, and a moved meeting reminds again.

entries.title: Immunization records list their doses
entries.body: Filing an immunization record now needs at least one dose ticked or added by name, for staff and parents alike. Doses already on file can be ticked too and are never recorded twice. Records chosen in the new-family form open in the same dialog once the family is saved.

entries.title: Several files, more places
entries.body: Pick several files in one go for immunization records (front, back and extra pages filed together), child and staff files, chat photos (one message each, in order) and photos shared from Care. Families hear about a batch of photos once, not once per photo.

entries.title: Every centre, not just the first
entries.body: Admins of agencies with several centres can now record immunizations and exemptions, manage medications, e-documents and invitation codes, and add children at every centre, not only the first one. The waitlist and invoice export cover all your centres too.

entries.title: Download photos from chats
entries.body: Any photo you open from a chat, a support ticket or a child's feed now has a Download button. On a phone it opens the share sheet so you can save it.

entries.title: Immunization spelled consistently
entries.body: Immunization is now spelled with a z everywhere in the portal, the help guides and the daily admin email.

entries.title: Simpler window buttons
entries.body: Close, minimise, maximise and more on popups, the chat window and the dial pad now use clean outline icons.

entries.title: A cleaner chat bar
entries.body: Every chat now has one rounded typing bar: + for emoji, voice notes and more, a paperclip to attach, and the send arrow at the end. On a computer, Enter sends and Shift+Enter starts a new line.

entries.title: OCCMS reports run in Reports
entries.body: Ontario agencies have an OCCMS reporting section in Reports: the Record of Attendance, the CWELCC monthly summary, capacity and vacancies, and the monthly attendance and fees sheets, each run for a month and exported like any other report.

entries.title: OCCMS reporting in Reports
entries.body: Ontario agencies can now open OCCMS reporting from the Reports screen as well as from Compliance.

entries.title: Meetings save instantly
entries.body: Scheduling, changing or cancelling a meeting now saves straight away. The emails and the Teams link go out within a minute, and if anything cannot be sent you will see it on your bell.

entries.title: Faster refreshes and saves
entries.body: The portal now asks the server for each thing once when a screen loads, and no longer redraws the whole screen a second time after you save. Badge and message counts also load with far less work.

entries.title: Meeting replies now go to sales@
entries.body: When you invite people to a KiddieTrac team meeting, their Accept, Maybe and Decline replies, and any email replies, now go to the sales@kiddietrac.com inbox instead of your personal email. Your first name still shows as the person inviting them.

entries.title: A clear Saved message for instant changes
entries.body: Settings that save the moment you change them, like notification sounds, notification choices and on/off switches, now show a Saved message, so you know the change went through. If a change could not be saved, you will see Not saved instead.

entries.title: Monthly attendance & fees by family
entries.body: Reports now has a by-family version of the monthly attendance & fees sheet. Run it for one family or every family in turn. Each family gets its own total line and the parent who signs. The whole-centre sheet is still there as its own report, and the day columns in both now show the date over the weekday, so they're easier to read.

entries.title: Privacy breach alerts: choose who hears
entries.body: Privacy breach alerts now go to the KiddieTrac platform team. Agency admins and centre directors are off by default. To turn them back on, go to Privacy breaches → Alert settings.

entries.title: Monthly attendance and fees
entries.body: A new monthly sheet shows each child's hours in care every day, total hours, parent, government and total fees, and space type, with a parent signature column when printed. Find it in Reports, and under OCCMS reporting for Ontario centres.

entries.title: Email links open properly
entries.body: Tapping a link in an email in KiddieTrac Email now opens it in your phone browser in the app, or in a new tab on a computer. Email addresses and phone numbers in an email open your mail or phone app.

entries.title: Closing a centre tidies up
entries.body: Closing a centre now clears the shifts still booked there after its last day, and tells you in its own message if any families are still open, with a button to go to Families. Group chats list only the people still in them.

entries.title: Saving prompt only when you save
entries.body: The Saving… / Saved bubble no longer pops up while you swipe or tap through tabs, or when a tab just loads a preview. It shows only when you tap a button, change a setting or submit a form.

entries.title: Steadier tabs in Message Centre
entries.body: On a phone, tapping Inbox, Archived, Texts or Website no longer makes the tab row blink and jump back to the first tab. The row stays put and slides gently to the tab you picked, and the same goes for every other tab row in the app.

entries.title: Tidier tab bars on phones
entries.body: Every row of tabs on a phone now stays on one line and slides with its arrows, including Curriculum, RSVP and Resellers, which used to wrap or run off the screen. Arrows appear as soon as the tabs need them and never show twice, and tabs no longer shrink when a page opens.

entries.title: Tell your centre you've paid by e-Transfer
entries.body: Sent an Interac e-Transfer? Open Pay by Interac e-Transfer on the invoice and enter the reference number from your bank, plus the amount if you paid part. Your centre confirms it, and the invoice updates. Until then it shows "waiting to be confirmed" and no reminders or late fees are sent.

entries.title: Confirm e-Transfers
entries.body: When a family enters the reference number for an Interac e-Transfer, admins and the centre director get an alert and an email. Check your bank, then open Accounting > e-Transfers to confirm (or the invoice's menu) to approve it. That records the payment and updates the invoice, full or partial. Reject it with a reason and the family is told why. Reminders and late fees pause while it waits.

entries.title: Interac e-Transfer tab
entries.body: Payment providers now has an Interac e-Transfer tab. Switch it on, enter your e-Transfer email, say whether Autodeposit is on (or give the security question and answer), and add your own instructions. Families see all of it when they choose to pay by e-Transfer, and it appears under How to pay on invoices. Use Preview to see exactly what they will see.

entries.title: Safe Arrival follows withdrawals
entries.body: When a child is withdrawn or taken off the day after a Safe Arrival alert, the alert now clears within five minutes and anyone who got it hears it is all clear. Their parents are not phoned, and they are no longer listed as not resolved at closing time. Alerts also only go to people still on staff for that room.

entries.title: Your customer number on every invoice
entries.body: KiddieTrac invoices now show your customer number (like KT-CUS-0002) under the invoice number: on the PDF, in billing emails and on Licence > Invoices & payments. Quote it with the invoice number when you pay.

entries.title: Cold reach sends all day, every day
entries.body: Queued cold-reach emails now go out around the clock, seven days a week, at the same pace of 2 every 15 minutes (up to 192 a day), so a big list gets through about five times faster. Change it any time in Follow-up settings.

entries.title: Copy a campaign
entries.body: Sales campaigns: Copy to a new campaign (from the ⋮ menu or the campaign header) makes a new draft with the same email, design and sender. Tick the box to bring the people on it too.

entries.title: Paste any list of email addresses
entries.body: Sales campaigns: paste addresses separated by commas, semicolons, spaces or new lines (or Name <address>) and every one is added. Repeats count once, and you see how many were found before you add them.

entries.title: Search and filter linked emails
entries.body: The Emails tab on users, families and contacts now shows how many emails there are, with a search box, filters (received or sent, attachments, mailbox, who, how it was linked, when) and sorting.

entries.title: Emails have their own tab
entries.body: Linked emails now sit in their own Emails tab on every record they can belong to: users, families (view and edit) and directory contacts.

entries.title: Family records: every tab when you view
entries.body: Viewing a family now opens the full record with all its tabs (Overview, Family, Guardians, Children, Photos, Emergency, Billing split) in view-only mode. Press Edit to make changes.

entries.title: You can see when it saves
entries.body: Saving anything in the portal now shows a small Saving… circle at the top of the screen, then a green ✓ Saved when it is done (or Not saved if something needs fixing). Works on desktop and on phones.

entries.title: Tighter lead record
entries.body: A lead record now reads as neat label and value rows on every screen, so the whole record fits on one desktop screen. Notes fit their words, and Edit still opens the full form.

entries.title: Leads read well on a phone
entries.body: On a phone, leads are tidy cards showing stage, value and follow-up (orange when due), with one-tap call and email. A lead record reads as compact rows, and Call, Email, Website and Map buttons sit at the top.

entries.title: Edit discount lines on proposals
entries.body: On a proposal, a discount line now takes a rate (% or $ off) or a dollar amount typed straight into its price box, and its words can be changed freely. Labels in that popup read clearly again.

entries.title: Delete proposals from the list
entries.body: Sales → Proposals now has 🗑 Delete in each row menu, handy for test proposals. A proposal that set up a customer stays.

entries.title: Chat sends instantly
entries.body: Messages show the moment you tap send, and you can send several in a row without waiting. Each one turns solid once it is delivered; if one fails, your words come back to the box.

entries.title: Folding customer sections
entries.body: In a customer's details, tap a heading such as Services and pricing or Account to fold it away. The stat cards on Customers are smaller too, and the owner shows the agency's first admin until you pick one.

entries.title: Customer details: agency, discounts, invoices
entries.body: A customer now opens with the agency in full (owner, address, contact, plan), every service with its discount and the totals before and after discounts, and each invoice opens with one click.

entries.title: Customers stat cards redesigned
entries.body: The cards on Sales → Customers now show circle graphs and 12-month trend lines, with no colour bands. iLearn is listed as a customer.

entries.title: Campaigns reach every subscriber
entries.body: Sales campaigns now go to everyone on the list who has not unsubscribed, including people who have not set up their KiddieTrac app yet. A held email now shows as held, not sent.

entries.title: Customers, under Sales
entries.body: Setting a lead to Won now creates the customer straight away, with a customer ID (KT-CUS-0001) and the services and pricing from the proposal they accepted or signed. Sales → Customers lists everyone with their monthly and yearly revenue, one-time fees, status, charts, and for superadmins what each customer owes and has paid (from Accounting AR/AP). A customer won without a signed proposal is flagged "no services yet". Once Approve & set up customer creates their account, the customer is linked to it.

entries.title: Proposal history and status
entries.body: Each proposal card shows when it was last changed, and warns you if it changed after the customer received it. ⋮ → 🕘 History shows where the proposal stands, plus every change, email, open, follow-up and signature, across all its revisions. Edits now say exactly which lines changed and how.

entries.title: Set a discount rate per proposal
entries.body: Adding a discount to a proposal (for example the 10% discount) now gives that line its own rate box. Change it to any % or $ amount for this proposal: the amount recalculates and the line text updates to match. Your catalogue discount stays as it is.

entries.title: Print proposals, and the date on every signature
entries.body: Proposals now have 🖨 Print beside Download, in the proposal ⋮ menu and on the page your customer signs. Before signing it prints with blank signature lines, so it can be signed on paper. Once signed it prints both signatures and their dates. Both sign forms now show the date being signed, and the Countersign popup uses the standard popup layout.

entries.title: Locking someone signs them out everywhere
entries.body: When you lock a person, centre or provider, everyone it locks out is signed out of every phone and computer right away. Any screen they still have open shows your paused-access message within seconds. App notifications to them pause until you unlock. Emails and texts still reach them. Anyone who also belongs to another, unlocked provider stays signed in there.

entries.title: Locked people now show as Locked
entries.body: When someone is sign-in locked (on their own, or through their centre or provider), their Status now reads 🚷 Locked in User management, on the family and child pages, and in the director staff list. Hover it to see which lock and since when. The account itself is untouched, so unlocking puts everything back exactly as it was. The user export marks them too.

entries.title: Let one person in past a centre lock
entries.body: When a centre or provider is locked, you can now let one person sign in again - for example a parent or educator moving to another centre - while the centre stays locked for everyone else. Use Sign-in lock in the person's row menu or on their page; it takes notes and emails your admins and directors. Each person's own lock can also be unlocked on its own.

entries.title: Agency overview stays put
entries.body: The Agency overview no longer jumps every 45 seconds while it refreshes in the background: the second row of widgets stays where it is.

entries.title: Lock and unlock sign-in
entries.body: Pause sign-in for one person, or a whole centre or provider, from Locked sign-ins, a person's page or the Centres list, then unlock it when you are ready. A centre lock never keeps out a parent who also has a child at another centre, and unlocking lets back in everyone it held. Each lock and unlock takes notes and emails your admins and directors. Emails, texts and emergency messages still reach the people who are locked.

entries.title: Parents confirm your privacy notice
entries.body: Each parent is now shown your privacy notice once in the portal and taps “I’ve read it”, with the date recorded. Data retention › Privacy & consent shows who has read it, and you can ask everyone again when your notice changes. Add your own privacy policy link there; until then parents see KiddieTrac’s.

entries.title: More you can clear out automatically
entries.body: Data retention settings now cover call recordings, walk GPS trails, and the logs of texts and emails sent. Each is off until you set a period and turn on automatic enforcement.

entries.title: Privacy requests
entries.body: When someone asks to see, correct or delete their information (or their child's), log it under Administration > Privacy requests. The 30-day deadline is worked out for you, the bell reminds you as it gets close, and one button downloads that person's or child's records as a single file to review before you send it.

entries.title: Two-factor sign-in for admins and directors
entries.body: Admin and director accounts now need an authenticator app or a passkey to sign in. If yours isn't set up yet, the portal walks you through it - it takes about a minute and protects every family's information on your account.

entries.title: Tighter privacy on files and records
entries.body: Uploaded files (child photos, documents, signed forms, consent receipts) now open only through the private, expiring links the portal gives you. Bank numbers and health notes are no longer copied into the activity log, and in Messages a colleague who shares a name now shows a partly hidden email instead of the full address.

entries.title: A faster portal
entries.body: Screens open faster, most of all in the first seconds of each minute, and the audit log opens in a fraction of the time.

entries.title: See which account you message
entries.body: When someone has more than one account, the new-message list now shows the account name beside their role, so your message reaches the account they actually use.

entries.title: Mark a drill not required
entries.body: On the Drill log, admins and directors can now use the ⋮ on a provider or centre drill to mark it not required there, with a reason. It stays on the list greyed out showing why, who and when, and its reminders and missed-drill notices stop. Use the same ⋮ to make it required again.

entries.title: Drill log: one view for each drill
entries.body: The Drills tab now shows each drill your centre must run with when it was last done, who recorded it and when the next one is due, and lists the drills recorded that month right underneath. Tap any drill to see everything recorded. Record a drill from the button at the top or from the drill itself, and the form opens with that drill already chosen.

entries.title: Safe Arrival closes the day for you
entries.body: A child who never arrived and was never marked absent no longer stays an open alert forever. At closing time Safe Arrival closes the check as "Not resolved by end of day", clears its alerts from your bell, and sends directors and admins one short list of who was not resolved. Directors and admins now also get the full-screen alert when a child is not here, with one tone, and all-clear notices no longer pile up as unread.

entries.title: Plans & pricing in tabs
entries.body: Plans & pricing now has its own tab for Plans, Add-ons, One-time services, Discounts and Proposal terms, each with a count, so you only see the section you are working on. It remembers the tab you were on.

entries.title: Search learns new screens
entries.body: The search box now picks up the words on new and changed screens as people use KiddieTrac, so a heading or setting you can see is a heading or setting you can search for. It only learns words built into KiddieTrac, never names or anything typed in.

entries.title: Search finds words inside screens
entries.body: The search box (sidebar, Ctrl-K and the phone launcher) now also finds the words on each screen and its subtabs: headings, field names, column titles and buttons. Try “evacuation time” or “texts & calls”. The result tells you where the words are, and opening it takes you to that subtab and highlights them. A screen whose name matches still comes first.

entries.title: Field trips: stats and circle graphs
entries.body: Field trips now opens with circle stats: upcoming trips (with the next one), permission slips signed and still waiting, past trips, Walk Watch walks, and how many children went on a trip. Below them: trips and walks month by month, how children travel, and trip fees from signed slips. Walks are counted separately from planned trips.

entries.title: Pickup countdown and alarm
entries.body: When your child is signed in, Today shows a countdown ring from check-in to pickup time. Tap −15 or +15 to move today's pickup for yourself, then turn on an alarm (at pickup or up to an hour before). It rings your phone even when the app is closed. The centre's own pickup time doesn't change.

entries.title: Observations open in a popup
entries.body: The 🌱 Observation tap in Log a moment, the ✨ quick action and the 👀 Observation tile on your Today screen now open the New observation form in a popup. You stay where you were: speak or type what you saw, use AI help, save, and carry on logging.

entries.title: Log a moment: add an observation
entries.body: Daily log → Log a moment has a new 🌱 Observation tap. It opens the Observations form with the child you picked already chosen, using the same learning domains and AI help, and takes you back to Log a moment when you save.

entries.title: Sign out a lost phone or kiosk remotely
entries.body: Settings → Security now lists every phone, tablet and browser signed in to your account, with Sign out on each and Sign out of every other device. A signed-out device goes straight back to the sign-in page, its Face ID / PIN unlock stops working, and it stops getting notifications. Administrators can do the same for anyone in their agency from the person's Sign-in & security card (📱 Devices · sign out), and directors for people at their centre. For a lost kiosk tablet, Centres → Kiosk mode → Sign out all kiosk tablets: the old kiosk link stops working at once. Every sign-out is in the audit log.

entries.title: Reply and send from your own mailbox
entries.body: Email can now reply, reply all, forward and send new messages from any mailbox signed in with Microsoft or Google, not only the KiddieTrac sales mailboxes. Gmail mailboxes send straight away. A Microsoft mailbox connected before today shows "reconnect once to send": choose Reconnect in Manage accounts and sign in with Microsoft once more. For a shared mailbox, your Microsoft 365 administrator gives you Send As. Mailboxes added with a password (IMAP) can still only be read here.

entries.title: Drill log: each educator's fire drill day, map and reminders
entries.body: On the Drill log's Educators tab, each row's ⋮ now lets a director or admin set when that educator runs their fire drill (weekly, monthly on the 2nd Tuesday or the last Friday, every 2 or 3 months, or a single date, at a set time), and add, replace or remove their drill map. The schedule and the next drill date show in the table. The centre maps card has left Settings. Settings → Notifications chooses who hears about drills: a reminder to each educator before their drill (30 min, 1 hour, the morning of, or the afternoon before), a morning-of notice to directors and admins, and a notice when a scheduled drill was not recorded. Each one can be switched off.

entries.title: AI in the email client: suggested replies and rewrites
entries.body: In Sales › Email, the ✨ AI button in a new message or reply gives three ready-to-send suggested replies to the email you are answering, or rewrites what you wrote: clearer, shorter, friendlier, more formal, spelling and grammar fixed, or rough notes turned into a full email. The suggestion goes into your message for you to read and change, with one-click Undo. Nothing is sent until you press Send.

entries.title: Subscribe or unsubscribe right from an email
entries.body: Open any email in the email client and a small button beside the sender shows where they stand on the KiddieTrac subscriber list: Subscribe, Unsubscribe, or Subscribe again. One click updates the list, and unsubscribing stops all KiddieTrac marketing email to them. Platform admins only.

entries.title: Send a campaign from any KiddieTrac mailbox
entries.body: Sales campaigns now have a Send from choice listing every KiddieTrac mailbox connected in Sales › Email (sales@, info@ and any you add). The campaign goes out from that mailbox and replies come back to it. If Microsoft will not send from it, that email is marked not sent with the reason, never sent from a different address.

entries.title: AI writing and pictures stay fresh
entries.body: Daily notes, weekly recaps, report cards, thank-you notes, summaries, lesson plans and AI drafts now steer away from the openings and stock phrases your centre has seen lately, and a draft that reads too much like a recent one is rewritten automatically. Lesson-plan pictures now vary too: the same activity gets a different picture from week to week instead of the same one every time.

entries.title: Ticking a row no longer opens it
entries.body: In every list with tick boxes (field trips, users, contacts, tickets, payroll and the rest), ticking a box now only selects that row. It no longer opens the record behind it. Click the row itself to open it.

entries.title: Users by role shows every role
entries.body: The Users by role card on Agency overview now lists every role your agency has, including home visitors, sales and any role you create, which appears straight away at 0. Only open accounts are counted, and the number in the middle is people: someone who is both a director and a parent counts once.

entries.title: Drill log moved to Staff
entries.body: Drill log, with each educator's fire drill renewal and expiry dates, now sits in the Staff section of the menu.

entries.title: Popups opened from a popup stay in front
entries.body: A popup opened from inside another one, such as an email opened from a person's record, now always stays in front. Close it and you are back where you were.

entries.title: Announcements: view the details and send again
entries.body: The ⋮ on an announcement now has View details: where and who it was for, who sent it, when it was written, scheduled and sent, its due date and reminders, how it went out, and the full message with its picture or PDF. Directors and admins also see every person it reached, when, and whether they have read it (and done it, when it asks for something). Send again resends it to everyone it reached or only to people who have not read it yet, by phone notification, email or text, and it shows as new for them. A phone call is never placed again.

entries.title: Open, download, print or forward a linked email
entries.body: On a person's or family's ✉️ Emails tab, each email now has a ⋮ menu. Open email shows the whole message as it was sent, with who it was from and to, the date and any attachments. Download saves it as an .eml file that opens in Outlook or Apple Mail. Print prints it with its details. Forward to someone sends a copy, from your own Microsoft mailbox when you have one connected, otherwise from the agency's email with replies coming back to you. Opening an email here never marks it read in the mailbox it lives in.

entries.title: Announcements dot shows what you haven't read
entries.body: The 📣 in the top bar now counts exactly the announcements still unread on your Announcements screen, and reading one there clears it straight away.

entries.title: New announcements greet you at sign-in
entries.body: When you sign in, any new announcement sent to you opens in a popup. Tap ✓ I've read this to mark it read, or Later to see it again next time.

entries.title: Add someone to the unsubscribed list
entries.body: Website, Subscribers, Unsubscribed now has + Add to unsubscribed: enter an email (and a name or reason) for anyone who asked by phone or email, and they never get marketing email. A confirmation email is optional.

entries.title: Weekly menu saves again
entries.body: Save menu now turns on as soon as you add a dish, and pressing Done saves your changes instead of leaving them unsaved.

entries.title: Room counts match your children
entries.body: When a child moves rooms they now count only in their new room, so a room card shows the right number of children.

entries.title: Today banner comes alive
entries.body: The Today at a glance banner now shimmers and shows its picture like every other screen.

entries.title: Submitted forms show counter-signing
entries.body: My forms, Submitted is now a table showing when you signed each form and whether it has been counter-signed, by whom and when.

entries.title: Every screen lines up
entries.body: Banners and the page under them now use the same full width on every screen, and lines that only repeated the banner are gone.

entries.title: Log medicine and clothes changes
entries.body: Log a moment now has Medicine (with the medicine and dose) and Change of clothes. Families see them on their child's day.

entries.title: Icons glow when you point at them
entries.body: On a computer, Home icons glow in their own colour when you hover over them, and the top bar and menu icons light up too.

entries.title: Centre map in the Drill log
entries.body: Add a photo or PDF of your centre's floor plan, with exits and the meeting place, right in the Drill log. Anyone can update it, and older maps are kept.

entries.title: Choose who hears about immunizations and drills
entries.body: Settings → Agency notifications → Immunizations & drills lets an admin switch immunization notices and fire or emergency drill notices off for educators and home visitors, centre directors or agency admins. Off means no bell, phone notification or email about that topic for that role.

entries.title: Educators see exactly their own children
entries.body: An educator's weekly attendance overview, allergy alerts, awards list, Walk Watch list and incident and report-card child pickers now show only the children enrolled in their own rooms, on every day of the week. Children who have left no longer appear, and a nightly check alerts us if any list drifts.

entries.title: Sub-tabs stay on screen and buttons line up
entries.body: On a phone, a child's At a glance record now keeps its sub-tab bar in view on every tab, not just Overview. Its top buttons sit in two even columns, with Archive last. Sub-tab bars no longer jump back to the first tab when you pick one, and buttons such as Add a passkey keep their full label.

entries.title: KiddieTrac emails use first names only
entries.body: Emails from the KiddieTrac team now show our people by first name only, for example in the NDA request.

entries.title: Changed proposals get a revision number
entries.body: When you change a proposal after it has been sent, it gets a new number: KT-Q-000022 becomes KT-Q-000022-R2, then -R3. More edits before you send it again stay on the same revision. The new number shows on the PDF, emails, the signing page and the lead history.

entries.title: Popup headers no longer hide pale boxes
entries.body: Light panels, chips and buttons inside a popup's coloured header (like the Cc/Bcc line in the Email log preview) are now see-through, so their text is readable.

entries.title: Proposal line items: longer text, reorder, fresh date
entries.body: When editing a proposal, a line item's description can now be as long as you need, and Enter starts a new line, which the proposal keeps. Use ▲ ▼ beside a line to move it up or down. When you change what the customer reads, the proposal's issued date becomes today, and a valid-until date you left alone moves forward by the same number of days.

entries.title: The "Are you still there?" countdown is always on top
entries.body: The sign-out countdown now shows above any open window, such as the dial pad, clock-in, a form you are signing or a photo, so you can always tap Stay signed in. Only something you actually do now counts as activity; a window opening on its own no longer keeps you signed in.

entries.title: Linked emails show on people's records again
entries.body: The Emails tab on a person's or family's record now shows the emails linked from your agency mailbox for everyone allowed to see them. If they cannot load, it now says so instead of saying linking is switched off.

entries.title: My forms uses the whole screen
entries.body: My forms now fills the window like the rest of the app. On a computer your forms sit side by side in a grid instead of one narrow column in the middle; on a phone they stack as before.

entries.title: Mark read and archive announcements
entries.body: On a computer, the ⋮ on each announcement now lets you mark it read or unread and archive it. Archiving only tidies your own list; open 🗄 Archived to bring one back. New announcements show a dot until you read them, and ✓ Mark all read clears them in one go. Delete only appears on announcements you are allowed to remove.

entries.title: Payslips live on My pay, not in Announcements
entries.body: New payslips no longer appear in your Announcements list. You still get the alert when one is ready, and it opens your pay screen, where all your payslips are kept.

entries.title: Home visitor Home matches the rest of the app
entries.body: Home visitors now get the same Home as everyone else: the slim banner, your visit numbers in one compact row on a phone, and Quick access tiles. The phone header is one tidy row with the settings gear, and the bottom bar has My reports and a big New visit button in the middle.

entries.title: Dial pad button moved to the top bar on phones
entries.body: On a phone, the round 📞 dial pad button now sits in the top bar beside the settings gear, instead of floating over the bottom of the page where it covered cards and tiles.

entries.title: Team messages popups refreshed
entries.body: New message, New group and Add people in Team messages now use the same popup as the rest of the app: your agency's colours in the header, the close button at the top, and Cancel and Create pinned at the bottom so they never scroll away.

entries.title: New visit, one tap from the bottom bar
entries.body: On a phone, a home visitor's bottom bar now has New visit where Daily log used to be. Daily log is an educator screen and never opened for home visitors.

entries.title: New message: emoji, photos and voice notes from the start
entries.body: In Message Centre, + New chat now opens the same popup parents use: your centre's colours, a ✕ to close, and Emoji, Photo and Voice note buttons so you can add them before the conversation even starts. It fits every phone, including iPhones using Display Zoom.

entries.title: A phone bar made for sales
entries.body: On a phone, the sales team's bottom bar now goes to Home, Pipeline, Leads, Website chat and Inbox. Before, two of its tabs opened screens that sales accounts don't have.

entries.title: KiddieTrac is on the App Store
entries.body: The KiddieTrac app is now on the App Store for iPhone and iPad, as well as Google Play for Android. Search "KiddieTrac" in the App Store, or use the App Store button in your KiddieTrac emails and on the sign-in page: https://apps.apple.com/app/kiddietrac/id6827700968
entries.body_fr: L’application KiddieTrac est maintenant sur l’App Store pour iPhone et iPad, en plus de Google Play pour Android. Cherchez « KiddieTrac » dans l’App Store, ou utilisez le bouton App Store dans vos courriels KiddieTrac et sur la page de connexion : https://apps.apple.com/app/kiddietrac/id6827700968
entries.title_es: KiddieTrac está en el App Store
entries.body_es: La app de KiddieTrac ya está en el App Store para iPhone y iPad, además de Google Play para Android. Busque "KiddieTrac" en el App Store, o use el botón del App Store en sus correos de KiddieTrac y en la página de inicio de sesión: https://apps.apple.com/app/kiddietrac/id6827700968
entries.title_hi: KiddieTrac अब App Store पर है
entries.body_hi: KiddieTrac ऐप अब iPhone और iPad के लिए App Store पर है, साथ ही Android के लिए Google Play पर भी। App Store में "KiddieTrac" खोजें, या अपने KiddieTrac ईमेल और साइन-इन पेज पर App Store बटन का इस्तेमाल करें: https://apps.apple.com/app/kiddietrac/id6827700968

entries.title: Add a card with your phone's camera
entries.body: Adding a card in Wallet or Autopay now shows clearly labelled card fields. On an iPhone in Safari, tap Card number and choose Scan Credit Card above the keyboard; on Android, choose Scan new card when your phone offers it. Your card goes straight to the secure payment form and is never stored by your centre.

entries.title: Close buttons no longer hidden under the iPhone clock
entries.body: On iPhones using Display Zoom or larger text, popups such as Fill & Sign forms and documents started under the status bar, hiding the ✕. They now start below it and use the full screen on every phone.

entries.title: Message your educators or the centre office
entries.body: New message now opens as a popup. Choose who it goes to: your child's educators, or the centre office (the director and office team), which your child's educators won't see. You can add emoji, a photo or a voice note.

entries.title: My Dashboard, and Today tidied up
entries.body: Your home page is now called My Dashboard. On Today, Due now sits right under the numbers, and the + on your child's photo responds to every tap. Buttons such as View certificate on Awards show their words instead of a small icon, and today stands out clearly on the attendance pattern.

entries.title: Parents can message the centre office
entries.body: When a parent writes a new message they can send it to their child's educators or to the centre office. Office messages go only to the centre's directors and the agency's admins; educators don't see them. They appear in the Message Centre as Centre office.

entries.title: Popups follow your brand colours
entries.body: On a branded (white-label) account, popup headers and buttons now use your brand colours instead of KiddieTrac's navy and teal.

entries.title: Tap + on your child for today
entries.body: On Today, tap the + on your child's photo to say you are running late, that they are sick, or that they are not coming today. The day's meals, naps, changes and play now sit at the top of the screen.

entries.title: Mark news read or remove it
entries.body: Each item in News has a ⋮ menu: mark it read or unread, or remove it from your list. New items show a dot until you read them, and Mark all read clears them at once. Removing an item only takes it out of your own News.

entries.title: Photo permission when you join
entries.body: New families now choose photo permission for each child while setting up their account. The primary parent makes this choice; other parents can see it in My settings → Photos.

entries.title: The primary parent chooses photo permission
entries.body: Only the family's primary parent's answer counts for photo permission now, and only they are asked. A family with no primary parent set still uses every parent's answer. Each family and parent record has a Photos tab showing the answers, with the paper form for the primary parent.

entries.title: Reminder to clock out when the room is empty
entries.body: Educators still on the clock after every child has left their room get an app reminder to clock out: 15 minutes after the last child leaves, then every 30 minutes, up to 3 times. Change it or switch it off in Clock settings → Reminders.

entries.title: View a user with every tab
entries.body: In User management, the ℹ️ View button now opens the full record with all the same tabs as Manage, in view-only mode. Nothing can be changed there; press ✏️ Edit to make changes.

entries.title: Settings use the whole screen
entries.body: Settings cards now fill the width of the screen on a computer instead of leaving empty space on the right. Email settings, Billing, Calendar, Clock, Payment providers and the other settings screens all line up in columns.

entries.title: Tabs scroll with arrows
entries.body: When a screen has more tabs than fit, they stay on one row and round ‹ › arrows at the ends slide them along. The tab you pick moves to the middle.

entries.title: Choose who sees linked emails
entries.body: Email settings → Link emails to people now has a "Who can see linked emails" section. Tick agency admins, centre directors (they see their own centres only), or name extra people. Only agency admins and the mailbox owner can link or unlink an email.

entries.title: Late drop-off on the child card
entries.body: If a family says their child will be dropped off late, tap ⏰ Late drop-off on the child's card and set the time. Safe Arrival waits until then, and the card shows who will drop off and by when. Children who are in have ⏰ Late pickup.

entries.title: Bigger bio and notes boxes
entries.body: The provider bio box is much taller when you edit a provider, at sign-up, and in your own profile. Other notes boxes now keep their full height too.

entries.title: Lunch and break reminders
entries.body: If your lunch or break runs past its limit, you get a reminder to tap I'm back. If you're still out a little later, your director or admin is told.

entries.title: Set lunch and break limits
entries.body: Payroll settings → Lunch and breaks now has limits (30 min lunch, 15 min break by default) and who is alerted when someone runs over.

entries.title: Running late? Tell the centre
entries.body: Running late for drop-off or pickup today? Tap Running late on your Today screen or home screen, give a time, and your child's educators are told. Nobody chases you before then.

entries.title: Late pickup on Safe Arrival
entries.body: Running late now covers pickup too: tap a child who is here, or use Late pickup on the Safe Arrival board, and the end-of-day alerts wait for that time. When a parent says they're running late you get a heads-up, and admins choose who is told in Safe Arrival settings.

entries.title: Coming back from lunch fixed
entries.body: Tapping I'm back after a lunch or break now ends it straight away, on the Time clock, the clock strip and the on-lunch reminder.

entries.title: Log a child running late
entries.body: When a family says their child will be in later, tap the child on Today and choose ⏰ Running late, then enter the time. Safe Arrival waits until then before asking the family or alerting anyone, and checks as usual if the child still isn't signed in.

entries.title: Drill log and Safe Arrival on Home
entries.body: Educators now have Drill log and Safe Arrival tiles on Home, and Safe Arrival is in the menu, showing who is due in for your rooms.

entries.title: Link emails to people's records
entries.body: Admins can now file emails from the agency's own mailboxes on the record of the parent, staff member or contact they are with, for an audit trail. Turn it on in Email settings. Emails link automatically by address, or with 🔗 Link to person in Email, and show under ✉️ Emails on the person's and the family's record. Every link and unlink is in the audit log.

entries.title: Printing works on phones
entries.body: Print now works from a phone's browser for invoices, statements, payslips, documents, certificates and reports, and prints only the document. In the KiddieTrac app, printing arrives with the next app update.

entries.title: Time fields start at now
entries.body: Tapping an empty time field, like in the Daily log, now starts at the current time instead of 9:00 AM, and date pickers open on today. On a computer, an empty time field fills in the current time when you click it.

entries.title: Clear warning for check-in without One-Tap
entries.body: Checking a child in or out by hand now shows a yellow warning in the middle of the screen, reminding you that parents should use One-Tap. It appears on the Today roster, the child's quick actions, the rooms screen, the Daily Overview and batch check-in.

entries.title: Popups open in the middle
entries.body: On phones, every popup and dropdown list now opens in the middle of the screen instead of at the top or bottom.

entries.title: Yellow glow while on break
entries.body: On lunch or a break, the edge of your screen glows yellow. When you tap to clock back in, we ask if you are back first, so a stray tap does not end your break.

entries.title: Speak it no longer repeats
entries.body: Dictating an observation with Speak it now writes each word once, even on Android phones. The New observation buttons are also clearer: Structure with AI, Write it myself, and Save observation is ready as soon as your draft appears.

entries.title: Easier-to-read buttons
entries.body: Buttons that are waiting for a change, like Save profile, now show dark words on light grey instead of an unreadable dark grey.

entries.title: Pick the term from a list
entries.body: On Report cards, the Term is now a dropdown of the recent quarters with this one already chosen, plus Another term for a name of your own.

entries.title: Clearer educator home screen
entries.body: Your home screen now has a Score card heading above today's points and a Children heading above the headcount and roster. Tapping a child opens a slimmer quick-actions card with shorter labels and an easy-to-read photo permission tag.

entries.title: Matching counts on your home screen
entries.body: Every count on a home-screen tile (My tasks, Forms to sign, Documents, Website chat) now looks the same: a small red number sitting on the top-right of the icon.

entries.title: Notification settings fit your role
entries.body: Settings → Notifications now lists only the kinds of notifications you can actually receive. Parents no longer see staff reminders, headcounts or the staff mailbox, and staff no longer see parent-only choices. If you are both staff and a parent, parent items are marked "as a parent". Staff-only alerts are also never sent to an account that is no longer on staff.

entries.title: Sign with your saved signature
entries.body: Save your signature and initials once in My settings, on the new Signature tab, or tick "Save this signature for next time" when you sign. After that, every signing screen offers "Use my saved signature": one tap signs that document, and each use is recorded. It is never applied without your tap, and you can remove it any time. Forms with initials boxes now let you tap to initial.

entries.title: Counter-signed forms now carry the counter-signature
entries.body: Since late October, counter-signed forms were emailed without the counter-signature page. That is fixed: the stamped copy is now made a minute after you counter-sign and emailed to the family and your forms inbox. Every form affected has been rebuilt and a corrected copy sent to both.

entries.title: Fully signed workflow documents are emailed
entries.body: When the last person signs a multi-step document workflow, everyone who signed and the person who started it now gets the signed document by email as a PDF.

entries.title: Photo permissions are enforced
entries.body: Every child now carries their family's photo permission. The tag picker marks children whose family said no (they cannot be tagged) and family-only children, and tells you which families will not see a photo. Admins and directors can record a signed paper form on Photo permissions.

entries.title: Photo permission for each child
entries.body: Choose, for each of your children, whether educators may share photos with your family only, include them in group photos other families see, or not photograph them at all. Marketing use is a separate choice. Change it any time in My settings, on the Photos tab.

entries.title: Privacy breach alerts
entries.body: Admins and the centre directors of a breach now get an email and a phone notification when a privacy breach is recorded, when it is judged a real risk of significant harm, when it is reported to the Privacy Commissioner, and when it is closed, plus a morning reminder while one is overdue. Emails show a summary only. Directors can open their own centres records, read-only. Admins choose who gets them, extra addresses, and which events under Privacy breaches > Alert settings. Privacy breaches is now in the Administration menu.

entries.title: Privacy breach register
entries.body: Admin > Privacy breaches is the record PIPEDA requires of every privacy breach, kept at least 24 months whether or not it was reported. Record what happened, the information and number of people involved, containment steps, your decision on a real risk of significant harm and why, and when you reported to the Privacy Commissioner and notified people. Every change and step is kept on a timeline, nothing can be deleted, and the whole register downloads as a spreadsheet.

entries.title: One-Tap code opens as a normal popup
entries.body: Tapping One-Tap now opens the code in a standard popup, with Print and Close always at the bottom, so they stay reachable on small screens and tablets.

entries.title: Safe Arrival stands down when a centre closes on the day
entries.body: If a centre is closed on the day, for example a provider off sick with no notice, Safe Arrival closes any checks it had already opened. The phone calls to the next guardian stop, staff alerts are marked read with an all-clear, and History shows Centre closed that day. Calls also stop as soon as a child is reported absent.

entries.title: Payment emails you can count on
entries.body: You now get an email when a refund is on its way, when an auto-pay payment does not go through, and for each instalment of your invoice on its own date.

entries.title: Billing emails reach every billing parent
entries.body: Invoices, reminders and receipts now reach a billing parent even before they accept their app invite. If auto-pay can't take a payment, the parent gets an email explaining what to do. Refunds, whether staff-made or automatic, are emailed too. Each instalment is emailed on its own date: when its period starts, or 7 days before it is due, whichever comes first.

entries.title: A confidentiality notice on every email
entries.body: Every email now ends with a short confidentiality notice asking anyone who receives it by mistake to delete it, destroy any copies and let the agency know.

entries.title: Search on every list tab
entries.body: Every list tab now has its search box: Phone calls, missed calls, voicemail and texts, text replies, RSVP events and file requests, and short lists that used to lose the box when they had only one entry.

entries.title: Search website chats
entries.body: In the Message Centre, the search box now stays on the Website tab and finds website chats by name, email or last message.

entries.title: Emoji picker that stays put
entries.body: On phones the emoji picker now opens as a neat grid that does not jump or resize, the ＋ shortcuts menu is smaller, and a message made of just one to three emoji shows them large.

entries.title: Payment alerts for the office
entries.body: When a family pays online - card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, autopay or a saved card you charge - agency admins and that centre's director get an alert straight away: who paid, how much, which invoice and what is left. A failed autopay or an automatic refund alerts you too. Payments now show in your bell, and each morning at 7 you get an email of the day before (only when there was any money).

entries.title: Card payments, refunds and autopay on your own Stripe
entries.body: Every family card payment now goes through your centre's own Stripe account (Finance > Payment providers): Apple Pay and Google Pay, saved cards, autopay, Charge saved card and refunds. Refunds, full or partial, now send the money back to the card. If a parent taps Pay twice they get the same payment, and anything charged twice is refunded to the same card straight away. A cancelled invoice can no longer be paid. Saving your Stripe keys now connects KiddieTrac to Stripe for you, so a payment finished after a parent closes the app is still recorded.

entries.title: Campaigns in colour, and Mail settings
entries.body: Campaign cards now carry a light colour by status: grey for drafts, purple for subscriber-email drafts, amber when waiting on approval or paused, teal when scheduled and approved, blue while sending, green once sent. The Platform Email screen is now called Mail settings.

entries.title: Every sign-in and sign-out of the day
entries.body: When a child is signed in and out more than once in a day, every visit now shows: in the Daily Overview table, the agency overview card, attendance reports and the parent daily summary. A child who comes back is shown as At Centre again. Attendance corrections can add a second visit.

entries.title: Lunch and breaks on the clock
entries.body: Educators can now tap the clock and choose Lunch or Short break. They come off the floor and out of ratios without ending their day, then tap I am back. Admins choose in Payroll settings whether lunch and breaks are paid (default: lunch unpaid, breaks paid). Clocking out with children still signed in now warns, names the children and who else is on the clock, and lets you go ahead.

entries.title: Mark unread from the message list
entries.body: In Email, each message now has a ✉️ button to mark it unread (or 📭 to mark it read) without opening it. On a computer the button shows when you point at the message. Shortcuts: Ctrl+U marks unread, Ctrl+Q marks read.

entries.title: Alerts and sounds per inbox
entries.body: Each mailbox in Email now has its own new-mail alerts in its settings: switch them off, or give that inbox its own sound so you can tell which one rang. It is your own choice; others who share the mailbox keep theirs.

entries.title: Connect any Microsoft mailbox
entries.body: Any work, school or personal Microsoft account (Microsoft 365, Outlook.com, Hotmail) can now be connected in Email with Sign in with Microsoft. No IDs or secrets to set up; some organisations may ask their IT admin to approve KiddieTrac the first time.

entries.title: Deleting an account in the app now closes it at once
entries.body: When a parent or staff member taps Delete my account in the app, the account is archived straight away, the same as removing it from the Users screen. They are signed out on every device, and you get an email. Their records stay under your retention policy, and you can reactivate the account if it was a mistake.

entries.title: The greeting and clock show your centre's time
entries.body: The greeting and clock at the top of the app now follow your centre's time zone, even when your phone is set to another one.

entries.title: Send an emoji on its own
entries.body: In chats with colleagues, picking an emoji now lights up the send arrow straight away, so a quick 👍 or ❤️ can go on its own without typing anything else.

entries.title: Each centre's records stay with its own team
entries.body: Directors now approve, edit and send things only for the centres they direct: time off, withdrawals, rooms, report cards, medication, payslips, voice calls and texts. Agency admins still work across every centre. If a parent at your centre also works for the agency, pausing their family no longer locks them out of their job.

entries.title: Tighter privacy between families, centres and agencies
entries.body: We reviewed who can see and change what across every role. Parents now only ever reach their own family: their children, messages, care logs and invoices. Directors work within their own centres, and every account stays inside its own agency. Invite and password links no longer reopen an account an admin has switched off, and imports and role changes only apply to people already in your agency.

entries.title: Clearer message when a network is briefly blocked
entries.body: If the server security filter briefly pauses requests from your network, sign-in and every screen now explain it in plain words and what to do, instead of showing the filter technical message.

entries.title: Microsoft emails show as they were sent
entries.body: In Email, messages from Microsoft 365 / Outlook mailboxes now show exactly as the sender designed them. Coloured headers and backgrounds that Microsoft used to strip, leaving white text on white, are back, including on older emails.

entries.title: Videos keep playing through updates
entries.body: When KiddieTrac updates while you are watching a photo-feed video, it now waits until you are done instead of refreshing the app under you.

entries.title: Email on phones opens without jumping
entries.body: Opening an email on a phone no longer makes the toolbar re-wrap and the message jump down a moment later, and the inbox list no longer spreads its rows apart after it loads.

entries.title: Email headers keep their colour in Outlook
